preconditions: The upstream fixture and direct Registry Service endpoint are ready.
assertions: Blob bytes are digest-verified and persisted progress is reused after interrupted transfers and Backend restarts.

checks.description: Verify a healthy full Blob response completes without an internal Range request.
Verify a disconnected full response resumes from the committed offset.
Verify consecutive interruptions advance the persisted offset.
Verify a timed out Range attempt saves its received tail.
Verify an idle full response resumes from saved progress.
Verify a slow full 200 response outlives the ordinary request timeout.
Verify an ignored Range response restarts safely from byte zero.
Verify a changed strong ETag causes a bounded full restart.
Verify a rejected range causes a bounded restart.
Verify concurrent readers share one upstream transfer.
Verify a restarted Backend resumes from persistent progress.
Verify a background task resumes after entering retry_wait.
Verify a real Podman pull completes through the Registry Service.

outputs: Per-check result and structured evidence including digest, byte count, Range offsets, transfer bytes, timeout settings, task ID, and restart result.
